title: Targeting freeze: demo-email-notifications-v2 serves true, rules cleared
notes: The terminal fully-rolled-out state: fallthrough true with the cluster rules cleared. Invisible in the evaluation data because the flag already served true to every context, and that is the point — its significance is structural, not statistical.
This is the last targeting change for demo-email-notifications-v2. The seven-day no-targeting-changes window opens now, so code removal becomes permissible around 29 August.
From here the flag needs nothing except to keep being evaluated, so that when evaluations later stop it is because code was removed rather than because nobody was watching.
